lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Two point three seven metres. Two best friends, Barshim and Tamberi. Not one miss between them.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Then the bar went up to two point three nine. Three tries each. Three misses each.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: An official offered a jump-off. One gold. One silver.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Tamberi slapped his hand and leapt into his arms.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Before Rio, Tamberi was told he might never compete again. He kept his ankle cast for five years. Tonight, it was right there on the track.

lines.speaker: TAMBERI
lines.text: I dreamed of this so many times.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Two golds… because two friends had both cleared…
